statement.zh: **协议**：SSH 1.x（Secure Shell (SSH) Protocol Version 1.x）。SSH 1.x 的地位由新文档的回溯描述确定：RFC 4253 §5 写明「Earlier versions of this protocol have not been formally documented, but it is widely known that they use 'protoversion' of “1.x” (e.g., “1.5” or “1.3”).」它是一条存在过但没有正式标准化文本的旧协议线。
statement.en: **Protocol**: Secure Shell (SSH) Protocol Version 1.x (SSH 1.x).The status of SSH 1.x is set by the retrospective description in the newer documents: RFC 4253 §5 says "Earlier versions of this protocol have not been formally documented, but it is widely known that they use 'protoversion' of “1.x” (e.g., “1.5” or “1.3”)." It is a protocol line that existed without a standardised text.

statement.zh: 2.0 重写的理由写在架构文档摘要里：「The SSH protocol consists of three major components: The Transport Layer Protocol provides server authentication, confidentiality, and integrity with perfect forward secrecy.」架构文档把前向保密描述为 2.0 传输层提供的属性，而旧协议线没有对应的标准化描述可依据。
statement.en: The reason for the 2.0 rewrite is in the architecture document's abstract: "The SSH protocol consists of three major components: The Transport Layer Protocol provides server authentication, confidentiality, and integrity with perfect forward secrecy." The architecture abstract presents forward secrecy as a property the 2.0 transport layer provides, and the older line has no standardised description to lean on.

statement.zh: §5 把适用范围收窄：「Information in this section is only relevant for implementations supporting compatibility with SSH versions 1.x.」兼容做法由新服务器让步：§5.1 的小标题即 Old Client, New Server，规定「the server SHOULD identify its 'protoversion' as “1.99”.」并要求使用 2.0 的客户端把它认作与 2.0 等同。
statement.en: Section 5 narrows its own scope: "Information in this section is only relevant for implementations supporting compatibility with SSH versions 1.x." The compatibility trick is a version string the newer server offers to older clients (§5.1, headed Old Client, New Server): it says "the server SHOULD identify its 'protoversion' as “1.99”." and requires clients on protocol 2.0 to treat that value as identical to 2.0.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 文档缺失与兼容过程本身都是问题：§5 说「the only known documentation of the 1.x protocol is contained in README files that are shipped along with the source code [ssh-1.2.30].」；§5.2 说明新客户端可能先发数据，于是「the old protocol may already be corrupt when the client learns that the server is old」，此时应关闭连接并按旧协议重连。
statement.en: Both the missing documentation and the compatibility procedure are problems: §5 records that "the only known documentation of the 1.x protocol is contained in README files that are shipped along with the source code [ssh-1.2.30]." and §5.2 notes a new client may send data first, so "the old protocol may already be corrupt when the client learns that the server is old", after which it should close and reconnect under the old protocol.

statement.zh:
RFC 4253 与 RFC 4251 同为 2006 年 1 月的 Standards Track 文档（署名 T.Ylonen，SSH Communications Security Corp，与 C.Lonvick, Ed.，Cisco Systems），头部都没有 Obsoletes 或 Updates 行；§5 记录当时的现实——许多实现已用 2.0，「but it is known that there are still devices using the previous versions」。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SSH 1.x的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: RFC 4253 and RFC 4251 are both January 2006 Standards Track publications (signed T.Ylonen, SSH Communications Security Corp, and C.
